metadata.value: success, business failure (bizfail) or technical failure (tecfail)
metadata.normalized_value: success, business failure (bizfail) or technical failure (tecfail)
metadata.evidence:
Upon completion of the execution of a given operation
each party independently declares its local outcome:
success, business failure (bizfail) or
technical failure (tecfail).
metadata.evidence_location: 523-526, Execution model of bilateral operations with potential exceptions
metadata.reason: Defines the outcome states modeled for bilateral contractual operations.

metadata.value: receiving the individual outcomes, compute a single outcome and notify it to the contractual parties and possibly to other parties that are entitled to follow the execution of the contract
metadata.normalized_value: receiving the individual outcomes, compute a single outcome and notify it to the contractual parties and possibly to other parties that are entitled to follow the execution of the contract
metadata.evidence:
To agree on the outcome of each operation and be able
to progress to the next one in harmony, the parties
rely on an output synchronizer that is responsible for
receiving the individual outcomes, compute a single
outcome and notify it to the contractual parties and
possibly to other parties that are entitled to
follow the execution of the contract.
metadata.evidence_location: 533-539, Execution model of bilateral operations with potential exceptions
metadata.reason: Explains how differing party outcomes are reconciled in the model.
